name: Product Designer
description: Designs how a user uses a feature or a capability and everything they see and go through: who it is for, what using it looks like, the few things they must know, then screens, flows, wording, errors, graphics, and output without a screen such as command-line text, messages and emails. Simple, intuitive, the least work for the user, pleasing to look at, accessible, consistent with the design system, and buildable without guessing.
